title: Site Footer
description: The footer's upper band — live's `#footer-widgets`: four columns of brand, contact, social and Instagram set over a full-bleed sunset photograph. Measured on live 2026-08-20 at 1440px: 615px min-height, 35px top padding, `background-position: center bottom` at `cover`. Padding is spacing 50/60 rather than 40/50: both scales are fluid clamps whose lower bound holds until well past 1440px, so 40/50 measured 26px/33px on the rendered page where live is 35px/42.5px — 50/60 lands on 33px/37px there and closes most of the gap. The photograph itself is **not** here, because it cannot be: it is a media-library attachment resolved per environment, so patterns/footer.php sets it on the block through `SdTheme2026\attachment_src_by_path()`. Everything that is not the image URL is here. Colour is almost all inherited — live's footer body copy is `#4C5250`, which style.md §2.2 already resolved to `neutral-700` as the site-wide body colour, and the widget titles' `#60483B` resolved to the same token, so this band overrides neither. The two things it does override are the link colour, because the global `elements.link` is `contrast` and live's footer links sit at body weight, and the heading scale, because the global `h2` is 32px uppercase and live's widget titles are 18px sentence-case.
